title: Copy the recorded bit when the auxiliary walk returns to zero
statement: The source core draws first~Bern(q),setswalk=first-old_bit,then adds fresh q-p coin-pair differences until zero,|walk|=L,or the symmetric capB. It returns old_bit at zero and first otherwise. Given the old bit distributed Bern(p),this realizes the exact conditional coupling kernel with Bern(p),Bern(q)marginals, without evaluating either probability. Uncapped excess disagreement<=1/(2L); capBadds L/Bto that bound while keeping exact marginals. The stated prior-ensemble new-call bound is2L-1and the capped maximum2B-1; this average is NOT automatically conditional on an arbitrarily selected stored bit.
